default/30132.htm.text: Abyssal Celebrant Cecktinon: May you have the blessing of Abyss... Here is the birthplace of all Dark Elves, the temple of the goddess Shilen. Please enter with a solemn mind.

Whatever the reason may be, I cannot refuse my friend's request. It has been less than ten years since Steelbender died, and I don't think it wou…
